verdict.rationale: The dots docs say plainly that scheduled runs exist: Pause "doesn't ... cancel future scheduled runs." The getting-started page shows a recurring weekday 9 AM job over four weeks requested in natural language, which is a true recurring schedule and not a one-off action. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on creating, listing, editing or deleting schedules, scheduling limits or recurrence semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: It doesn't stop every delegated task or cancel future scheduled runs.
